requirements.finding: The current audit has no provider authority and a zero external-spend cap. Historical V2-06 authority is explicitly non-transferable and records the exact resources, USD 3 finite cap, USD 2/month R2 ceiling, RunPod read-only boundary, and no V2-07 authority.

Approved scope and recorded rates reconcile: one Free Cloudflare Worker plus one Workflow, one private Standard R2 bucket, Neon Free project, Google test project, immutable worker release, and existing paired-device scope; Cloudflare/R2/Neon/Google base rates are zero, R2 overage is USD 0.015/GB-month above 10 GB, and the two pre-existing RunPod volumes are separate at USD 3.50/month each (USD 7/month total). The actual R2 count/size supplied is 16 objects/32.1 MB, but that inventory predates the observed output deletion, so post-delete inventory/hash read-back is not proven.

Better Auth identity and negative cross-tenant refusal are observed, but the supplied second-account record has no positive second-tenant project/object/device/lease fixture. Hosted non-superuser RLS enforcement and real private-R2 hash parity remain unproven; the second account only observes an empty Library/devices view, unavailable foreign project, CPU_ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND, and no foreign signed URL.

The supplied deployment record contains an exact eight-name Worker secret allowlist and records no values. The Neon runtime role has exact grants, FORCE RLS, and SELECT-only hosted_render_plans evidence. This is an allowlist/grant proof, not permission to inspect secret values.

The supplied resource truth records one Worker and one HostedVideoWorkflow with private R2, Google auth, personal-worker CPU execution, and GPU disabled. Primary cancellation/reconnect is live-proven, but hosted Workflow restart/resume, lease expiry/replay, stale-result rejection, and late-result fencing are not proven. Current source fd773ed is not the deployed application commit 1ad68ea, so final deployed-source rollback is also open.

Cloud Run is explicitly superseded by the active account-owned personal-worker decision; current architecture records zero Cloud Run jobs required. Therefore no Cloud Run scale-to-zero ASR/render parity claim is made or proven. Windows/macOS worker install/lifecycle and one-account ASR/render evidence exist, but this does not replace the missing hosted two-account/recovery proof.

Backup and disposable-restore verification pass at migration 36/36 with exact grants/FORCE RLS and disposable database count zero. The live offline-worker cancellation also reaches terminal CANCELLED and reconnects. Hosted Workflow restart/resume, lease expiry/replay, stale-result rejection, and late-result fencing remain unproven, so the recovery requirement is not fully accepted.

Real signed-in Chrome records primary owned ASR/render/review/cancel and second-account negative refusal. Installed-Chrome 44/44 is provider-free fixture evidence and is explicitly not hosted deployment proof. The missing positive second-tenant and hosted replay gates prevent full Chrome acceptance.

The supplied media-worker-v0.1.11 record is marked GitHub immutable; Windows x64 unsigned-beta install/update/autostart/offline/reconnect/sleep/revoke/uninstall and macOS universal2 ad-hoc DMG/install/reconnect evidence are recorded. The selected unsigned/ad-hoc non-notarized trust modes are intentional and non-blocking.

Supplied read-only inventory records zero Pods, endpoints, active/flex workers, private templates, and clusters; zero RunPod mutations/workers started; GPU transport DISABLED_FAKE_ONLY. Two retained 50 GB EU-RO-1 volumes remain at USD 3.50/month each (USD 7/month total), separate from V2-06. Provider-side Serverless scale-to-zero qualification belongs to V2-07 and is not proven.

Rollback/restore is evidenced for prior deployed source 8e96575 and restored health HTTP 200. No supplied record exercises rollback from final deployed source 1ad68ea / Worker 5ffa68ef-8a4e-4784-a3cb-d02320ce5cc2; the current repository source is fd773ed and deployment parity is explicitly false.

The safety hold is correct: current authority is none/$0, no live provider call or mutation is allowed, GPU/RunPod mutation is forbidden, workers started are zero, GPU transport is disabled, and V2-07 action is false. This proves V2-07 has not started; it does not make V2-07 safe to start because the P1 gates remain open.
